corrections.previousValue: Oishida → Ginzan Onsen (the anchor transfer, carried with luggage): Hanagasa Bus, Ginzan Line, ≈35-40 min, ¥1,000/adult one-way, cash only (¥500 child or disabled companion), no reservation needed. The operator runs a different timetable per season, each on its own page — the Apr 1 – Oct 24, 2026 table is the one covering this trip, and it carries more daily departures than the Dec 1 – Mar 31 winter table. First bus leaves Oishida ≈6:40; the last one in reaches Ginzan Onsen at 18:21. ⚠ The operator's summary page still advertises 5 round trips a day while its seasonal timetable lists more — read the timetable itself, and confirm the day of. Missing a bus can mean waiting over two hours, and the longest gap falls around midday. Board early with the group's luggage; if the bus can't take it all, a taxi (≈20 min, ≈¥6,500-8,000/car, 2-3 cars for 8 people — call Ōbanazawa Taxi 0237-23-2525 ahead) is the fallback.

corrections.correctedValue: Comparable Ginzan Onsen ryokan open reservations three months ahead at the START of the month, not three months to the day — Ryokan Matsumoto publishes 「予約開始は3か月前の月初となります」, which puts the window for an October stay at Jul 1, 2026. It has been open for weeks, which is what makes this the trip's most time-critical booking. Call Ginzanso directly (0237-28-2322) as well as checking online.
corrections.claim: Ryokan Matsumoto's stated reservation window opens at the start of the month three months before the stay, so an Oct 20–23, 2026 stay became bookable on Jul 1, 2026 — not around Aug 1, 2026
